summary: Iterates the eight 92-byte struct entries beginning at this+15 dwords (this+0x3C). Each entry's leading string is compared with a2 — case-insensitively via sub_566810 when a3 is non-zero, case-sensitively via strcmp when a3 is zero — and on a match the whole entry is reset through PerIndexStructFieldResetter(this, index). No-op when a2 is null or empty.

local_names.this: owner object holding the eight-entry array at this+0x3C
local_names.a2: string key matched against each entry's leading string
local_names.a3: non-zero selects case-insensitive matching, zero selects case-sensitive matching
local_names.v5: string pointer advancing 92 bytes per entry

operations.description: The matching loop only runs when a2 is non-null and strlen(a2) is non-zero
Walk indices 0..7 over the eight 92-byte entries whose string base is v3+15 (this+15 dwords), advancing v5 by 92 bytes per iteration
When a3 is non-zero the comparison is case-insensitive, evaluated as sub_566810(v5, a2) != 0
When a3 is zero the comparison is case-sensitive, evaluated as strcmp(v5, a2) == 0
On a match, PerIndexStructFieldResetter(v3, v4) resets the matched entry at the current index
